headlines.title: 央行上海总部：扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策 积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Firmly implement moderately loose monetary policy, actively push financial institutions to tap effective credit demand
headlines.summary_en: The PBoC Shanghai Head Office held its H2 2026 work conference on August 4. The meeting stressed solid implementation of a moderately loose monetary policy and actively guiding financial institutions to tap effective credit demand. All structural monetary policy tools should be fully utilized. Policies under the "five major financial articles" 1+N framework should be implemented. The "technology board" of the bond market should continue to deliver results in Shanghai. Financial reform and opening-up should be steadily deepened, with improvements to the foreign exchange management system. New policies on high-level opening of cross-border trade and investment financing, overseas lending, and overseas listings should be implemented.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 广州有银行住房商贷利率最低可至2.7% 分析人士：更像针对特定人群的“价格战”
headlines.summary: 目前多数城市已经取消了住房贷款利率下限，但仍维持在3%以上。广州此前便有银行将住房贷款下调至3%以下，随后均又调回3%。不过，汇丰银行广州分行称，住房贷款利率最低可至2.7%。“未来银行个人住房贷款利率大体上也不会降，3%基本上是底线了，只能说只针对部分特定客户可以给到2.7%。”上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进对记者表示，此类最低利率门槛很高，并非人人都能享受，更像是一种针对特定人群的“价格战”。（每经）

headlines.title_en: Guangzhou banks cut residential commercial loan rates to as low as 2.7%; analysts see it more as a 'price war' targeting specific groups
headlines.summary_en: Most cities have removed the lower limit on mortgage rates, but they remain above 3%. In Guangzhou, some banks previously cut mortgage rates below 3% but later reverted to 3%. HSBC's Guangzhou branch, however, says its minimum mortgage rate can reach 2.7%. "In the future, banks' personal mortgage rates generally won't fall either—3% is essentially the floor. It's just that certain specific clients can be offered 2.7%," said Yan Yuejin, deputy director of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute. He noted that such minimum rates have very high thresholds and are not available to everyone, more like a "price war" targeting specific groups. (NBD)

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: Decision to take countermeasures against US compliance testing company
headlines.summary_en: Upon approval by the national anti-foreign sanctions coordination mechanism, the "Decision on Countermeasures Against U.S. Compliance Testing Company" is hereby announced, effective from August 5, 2026. Recently, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has intensively issued negative measures targeting China, seriously infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises. U.S. Compliance Testing Company has assisted and supported the FCC's measures, endangering China's sovereignty, security, and development interests.

headlines.title: 中国对6家美国实体采取反制措施
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公布《关于对应用DNA科学公司等6家美国实体采取反制措施的决定》，自2026年8月5日起施行。此举是对近期美国以所谓“强迫劳动”为由制裁中国企业的回应，中方认为此举严重违反国际法和国际关系基本准则，严重侵犯中国主权、安全、发展利益。根据《中华人民共和国反外国制裁法》相关规定，中方决定将应用DNA科学公司等6家美国实体列入反制清单，禁止中国境内组织、个人与其进行有关交易、合作等活动。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China imposes countermeasures on six US entities
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced the "Decision on Countermeasures Against Six U.S. Entities Including Applied DNA Sciences," effective from August 5, 2026. The move is a response to recent U.S. sanctions on Chinese companies under the pretext of so-called "forced labor," which China considers a serious violation of international law and basic norms of international relations, and a serious infringement of China's sovereignty, security, and development interests. Under the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China, China has decided to place six U.S. entities, including Applied DNA Sciences, on the countermeasures list, prohibiting Chinese organizations and individuals from engaging in relevant transactions and cooperation with them. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson answers questions on countermeasures against a series of negative China-related measures by US FCC and DHS
headlines.summary_en: The relevant measures of the U.S. Federal Communications Commission and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's inclusion of relevant entities on the so-called "Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List" seriously violate the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and seriously harm China's legitimate rights and interests. China has no choice but to take necessary countermeasures in response, including: strengthening export controls on drones and their key components and technologies to the U.S., suspending factory follow-up inspections conducted by U.S. certification bodies on behalf of designated Chinese compulsory product certification bodies, placing U.S. Compliance Testing Company on the countermeasures list, initiating a national security trade investigation into imported printing, copying and office equipment, and placing six U.S. entities on the countermeasures list, among others.

headlines.title: 商务部：对相关进口打印复印办公设备发起对外贸易国家安全立案调查
headlines.summary: 依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定，为了维护对外贸易秩序，商务部可以自行或者会同国务院其他有关部门，就对外贸易中有关国家安全利益的事项进行调查。初步信息显示，装有外国系统软件的进口打印复印办公设备可能影响对外贸易中的国家安全利益，符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定的情形。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Initiates national security investigation into imports of printing, copying, and office equipment
headlines.summary_en: Under Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, in order to maintain foreign trade order, the Ministry of Commerce may, on its own or together with other relevant State Council departments, investigate matters concerning national security interests in foreign trade. Preliminary information indicates that imported printing, copying and office equipment installed with foreign system software may affect national security interests in foreign trade, meeting the circumstances stipulated in Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law.

headlines.title: 商务部：加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制
headlines.summary: 根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，为维护国家安全和利益、履行防扩散等国际义务，决定加强无人机相关两用物项对美国出口管制。现将有关事项公告如下：对列入《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》的无人机及其关键零部件、相关技术对美国出口，逐案从严审核，不适用许可便利措施。本公告自公布之日起正式实施。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Strengthens export controls on dual-use items related to drones to the U.S.
headlines.summary_en: In accordance with the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on Export Control of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China, and for the purpose of safeguarding national security and interests and fulfilling international obligations such as non-proliferation, export controls on drones-related dual-use items to the U.S. are hereby strengthened. The following is announced: exports of drones and their key components and related technologies listed in the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China to the U.S. will be subject to strict case-by-case review, and permit facilitation measures will not apply. This announcement takes effect from the date of publication.

headlines.title: 光模块传闻搅动市场，机构和产业链分析：落地可能性小、影响可控
headlines.summary: 据中新网援引相关报道，监管美国电信行业的联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在制定相关措施，计划禁止进口中国新型号的光收发模块。光收发模块主要用于数据中心内部的高速光纤数据传输。美国官员希望2026年内公布并实施禁令。不过，知情人士称，该限制仍可能被修改或搁置。记者联系了多家机构和产业链公司，受访人士普遍认为，历史上也出现过多次这类信息，信息真假难辨，无需过度猜测，且美国严格禁止进口中国光模块的可能性较小。即便消息为真，从过往应对来看也影响可控。（21世纪经济报道）

headlines.title_en: Optical module rumors stir market; institutions and industry chain analysis: low likelihood of materializing, limited impact
headlines.summary_en: Citing related reports from China News Service, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC), which regulates the U.S. telecom industry, is drafting measures to ban imports of new Chinese optical transceiver modules, primarily used for high-speed fiber-optic data transmission within data centers. U.S. officials aim to publish and implement the ban in 2026. However, sources say the restriction may still be revised or shelved. Reporters contacted several institutions and industry chain companies, and interviewees generally said that similar information has appeared multiple times historically, making it hard to distinguish truth from rumor, so there is no need for excessive speculation, and the likelihood of the U.S. strictly banning imports of Chinese optical modules is low. Even if the news is true, based on past responses, the impact would be manageable. (21st Century Business Herald)
